mechanism.family: same physical scene/camera/sensor family; new rational parameter holdout
mechanism.sampling_change: expanded latent sampling distribution, not the historical six fixed materials/three depths/discrete noise tape
mechanism.photo_bias_and_noise: independent integers[-1000,1000]/100000; one shared bias per view
mechanism.materials: three new base colors; original A4-V patterned view variation eta=1/10 except all-equal full negative eta=0
mechanism.anchors: original A8 tape/acquire, independent of photo errors
mechanism.tasks: one correct + six independent nonzero signed magnitudes integer[1000,80000]/10000; reject accidental mean/median symmetry; shuffle
mechanism.clipping: exact ideal pixel integral + photo noise + shared photo bias, then one clip
mechanism.split_unit: independently generated world; repeated incumbents are not independent scenes
